get.description: SBE-8.12 additive contract registration. Session identity and server-owned selected-view authorization determine revision-bounded native, inherited or overlay provenance. Returns the complete retained metadata list for one item; query parameters are rejected. Missing or concealed items return the stable error envelope without exposing provenance.

get.summary: Download verified original bytes from authorized revision-bounded item provenance
get.description: SBE-8.12 additive contract registration. Query parameters are rejected. Authorization is resolved before and after the out-of-transaction CAS read; missing, unretained or concealed provenance is denied without disclosure. Content-Type is the original media type, not a fixed PDF or octet-stream type. The success body is raw bytes, not a JSON envelope; errors retain the shared JSON error envelope.

200.description: Verified original file bytes with an attachment filename

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment with header-safe ASCII fallback and RFC 5987 UTF-8 filename
